title: EventBus bound method unregister identity contract

contract.bound_method_identity: EventBus identifies bound methods by their __self__ target and __func__ function rather than bound-method object identity alone
contract.cross_instance_bound_method_lookup: A bound method retrieved again from the same object is recognized as the registered callback
contract.successful_unregister: unregister() returns True when the equivalent bound method listener exists
contract.removal_effect: The matching bound method listener is removed from the registry
contract.post_unregister_delivery: The removed bound method receives no subsequent events
contract.registry_stability: Bound method unregister leaves the listener registry structurally consistent
contract.permission_enforcement: Bound method unregister continues to require the events permission
